entries.title: Club Systems Membership Data Preview
entries.content: [redacted-club] Dashboard Timesheet Messages Golf Plus NEW! Facilities Contacts Memberships Users Reports Search Tools Need Help? brs chatbot Sign Out Club Systems Membership Data Preview BRS and Club Systems Joint Statement This tool helps you to merge data to and from the BRS tee time booking system with other systems. The left hand column has the Club Systems membership data, the midde column has the current BRS membership data and the right hand column shows what the BRS membership data will be after the update. Different fields are colour coded in different ways, depending on their status. These are as follows: Update/Add When the record will be added or updated in BRS. Disable When the record will be disabled in BRS. Fault When there is a fault which means the BRS record cannot be added/updated. Warning When there is an inconsistency with the Club Systems data and/or a record cannot be updated. Different When the BRS value is different from the Club Systems value, but may not be updated. entries.title: Club Systems Membership Category Mapping
entries.content: [redacted-club] Dashboard Timesheet Messages Golf Plus NEW! Facilities Contacts Memberships Users Reports Search Tools Need Help? brs chatbot Sign Out Club Systems Membership Category Mapping Warning: 'Enable Membership Type Synchronisation' is disabled. BRS membership data will NOT synchronise with Club Systems membership categories. You can still choose to include/exclude Club Systems membership categories. This tool maps Club Systems membership categories to BRS membership types. This allows you to create one BRS membership type, representing one or more Club Systems membership categories. It is useful to create Club Systems Membership Type Maps when membership data is imported from other sources. The Club Systems membership data may include billing categories, rather than playing categories, which are not best suited for tee time management. Import Club Systems Membership Categories: If Club Systems synchronisation has been configured, any Club Systems membership categories will be imported automatically, when this button is clicked. There are currently no Club Systems membership category maps configured. Please click the 'Import Club Systems Membership Categories' button to import any categories from your Club Systems software.
